CommunityApplications.Profile:
Smart, safe, self-hosted file organization for your Unraid server.
Unraid File Organizer scans the folders you allow, intelligently classifies every file — Windows installers, Android APKs, OS ISOs, media, archives, documents — and moves each one to a sensible destination like data/apps/windows/media/ or data/isos/windows/. Nothing moves without a preview, and every move can be undone.
FEATURES • Checkbox allow-list locations — unchecked folders are never scanned • Never-touch list; /boot, system shares and appdata are hard-forbidden • Smart classification incl. PE/APK binary analysis and ISO OS detection • Custom regex rules and per-category destination overrides • Dry-run by default with one-click undo • Optional local LLM assist (Ollama) for low-confidence files • Scheduled dry-run digests via Discord / ntfy / generic webhooks • Duplicate detection with journalled quarantine • Folder-level units: game/app directories move whole • Media library mode: Plex/Jellyfin-style TV & movie routing
GETTING STARTED Open the WebUI, add your messy folder under Allowed Locations, tick its checkbox, Scan, Build Plan, review, then Apply (keep Dry Run on until you trust it).
